entities.name: Northwest Passage (Amundsen)
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Roald Amundsen completed the first navigation of the Northwest Passage after a 3-year voyage. Centuries of failed attempts had killed thousands. He later became the first to reach the South Pole.
